Input: exercise "jogging (8km/h)" MET=8.3, weight w=70 kg, duration min=30.
Formula kcal=MET x 3.5 x w/200 x min = 8.3 x 3.5 x 70/200 x 30. ...

map.按体重/时长定制消耗，体重越大、时间越长消耗越高，便于做热量账。: Customize consumption by weight/duration; larger weight and longer time mean higher consumption, for a calorie ledger.
map.误差约 ±10–15%，受个体代谢、地形、强度波动影响；作热量账与趋势参考足够，: Error about +/-10-15%, affected by individual metabolism, terrain and intensity fluctuation; enough for a calorie ledger and trend reference, not a precise value
map.MET（代谢当量）=该活动耗氧相对安静状态的倍率，1 MET≈3.5 ml/kg: MET (metabolic equivalent) = the multiple of that activity's oxygen use relative to rest; 1 MET approx 3.5 ml/kg/min; general formula kcal = MET x 3.5 x weight/200 x minutes. This tool has 30+ built-in MET values for walking, running, cycling, swimming, jumping, etc.
